FOREWORD This Indian Standard was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards, after the draft finalized by the Pesticides Sectional Committee has been approved by the Food and Agriculture Division Council. Triadimefon, technical is employed in the preparation of fungicidal formulations.

Triadimefon is the accepted common name by the International Organization for Standardization ( IS0 ) for l-( 4-chlorophenoxy )-3, 3-dimethyl-1-( lH-1, 2, 4-triazol-l-y1 ) butanone. For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard IS complied with the final value, observed, or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS 2 : 1960 `Rules for rounding off numerical values ( revised )`. The number of significant pIaces retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.

DETERMINATION A-l PRINCIPLE Triadimefon content is estimated on a gas chromatograph using a flame ionization detector. Dioctyl adipate is used as internal standard. A-2 APPARATUS A-2.1 Microlitre Syringe, 5-10 ~1 capacity. OF TRIADIMEFON

CONTENT of Reference Standard Solution

A-4.2 Preparation

Weigh accurately 0.2 g triadimefon reference standard into a loo-ml volumetric tIask, add to it 10 ml of internal standard solution and dilute to the mark with acetone. Shake we11 to homogenize. A-4.3 Preparation of Sample Solution

A-2.2 Gas Chromatograph The instrument equipped with a flame ionization detector and may be coupled to a printer-plotter cum integrator. The operative parameters are suggested below, which can be changed, in any other instrument employed, provided standardization is done: Column Glass, 1.8 m length and 2 mm ID packed with 10 percent OV 17 on Chromosorb WHP ( 100 - 120 mesh )

Weigh accurateIy a quantity of sample so as to contain about 0.22-0.23 g of triadimefon into a lOO-ml volumetric flask add to it 10 ml of internal standard solution and dilute to the mark with acetone. Shake we11 to homogenize. A-4.4 Determination Inject 3 ,l reference standard soIution into the gas chromatograph with the help of a microlitre syringe. From the integrator, print out and note the peak areas of internal standard and triadimefon. Similarly, inject the same volume of sample solution and note down the peak areas. Compute the percentage of triadimefon content in the sample. A-5 CALCULATION Triadimefon content, percent by mass where
